headline.purpose: Prose h2; heading weight follows the inherited/browser context.

label.purpose: Uppercase documentation labels. H2 semantics for section headings; p for ordinary specimen labels.

quote.purpose: Quote/specimen text rather than general interface copy.

shadows.name: current-marker
shadows.purpose: Current documentation page and selected command option.

shadows.name: modal-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Native dialog backdrop color; not a box-shadow. Native top layer governs modality.

motion.name: mizu-ease-expo
motion.purpose: CSS expo and Motion EASE_EXPO share this curve.

motion.name: mizu-ease-wipe
motion.purpose: CSS wipe and Motion EASE_WIPE share this curve.

motion.name: mizu-ease-spring
motion.purpose: CSS spring token; distinct from the Motion constant.

motion.name: motion-ease-spring
motion.purpose: EASE_SPRING in motion/easings.ts; preserve the source distinction.

motion.name: mizu-duration-med
motion.purpose: Dialog entrance from opacity .6 and translateY(16px).

motion.name: reveal-default
motion.purpose: Reveal default with y: 32px, x: 0, once: true; reduced mode is opacity 1 and duration 0.

motion.name: mask-line
motion.purpose: MaskLine expo reveal; reduced mode removes travel and timing.

motion.name: presence
motion.purpose: Presence enter y: 8px and exit y: -8px; reduced mode keeps opacity 1 and duration 0.

motion.name: page-wipe
motion.purpose: Page wipe from -101% to 101%; promise resolves at 500ms; reduced mode resolves immediately. Layer token: --mizu-z-wipe: 90.

motion.name: magnetic-spring
motion.purpose: Pointer-following Magnetic springs; reduced motion disables travel.

motion.name: tilt-spring
motion.purpose: Tilt rotation springs; reduced motion retains a resting surface.

motion.name: marquee-default
motion.purpose: Package Marquee, with pause control; not the separate site 28s utility. OS reduction stops motion, wraps content and hides duplicate row/control.

motion.name: soft-type
motion.purpose: Variable-type specimen; OS reduced motion fixes wght 600 and wdth 100.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Diamond rotates from 45deg to 405deg; OS reduced motion removes the animation.

motion.name: os-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shared CSS media-query fallback. Dedicated marquee, soft-type and spinner rules establish static states; html scroll-behavior becomes auto.

motion.name: local-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: [data-motion="reduced"] descendants and pseudo-elements. MotionPreferences reduced={true} sets the scope and MotionConfig always; default follows OS. Marquee clears travel, allows horizontal scroll and hides the duplicate row.

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Button.tsx medium variant; loading behavior remains in the React implementation.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-button ds-solid">Explore <svg class="ds-arrow" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1.5 10.5L10.5 1.5M10.5 1.5H4M10.5 1.5V8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 26px 28px; border: 0; font: 11px var(--mizu-font-mono, "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", monospace); letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms ease, color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, opacity 300ms ease; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; } .ds-arrow { flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 300ms var(--mizu-ease-expo, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-button:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mizu-accent, #ff4d1c); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--mizu-radius, 2px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button, .ds-arrow { transition-duration: .01ms !important; } } .ds-solid { background: var(--mizu-accent-fill, #d23e0e); color: #fffaf4; } .ds-solid:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mizu-accent-fill, #d23e0e), #000 12%); }

narrative.overview:
Mizu preserves the incumbent warm material and editorial world: dark ink,
raised ink surfaces, paper text and a vermilion signal. Its reversed light
surface uses the same roles. Compact structural labels and dense, aligned data
sit beside broad headings and generous separation. The atmosphere is precise,
tactile and readable.

Motion follows cause: selection travels, disclosure unfolds, a changed value
settles and drag tracks the hand. CSS handles transient feedback; Motion handles
interruption and layout. Content remains useful at rest. Signature experiences
retain material continuity: comparisons reveal two versions, reordered sequences
retain identity, transactional actions communicate actual promise state and
history retains the information changed.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ink and paper, with vermilion reserved for signal and action.
Broad Archivo headings, quiet mono structure and expressive serif specimens.
Hairline rules, precise surfaces and state-bearing diamonds.
Purposeful motion with useful reduced-motion states.
Readable, inspectable demonstrations of real tasks and states.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body:
Use the accent to express action, selection or position;
the diamond is not repeated merely to fill space.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body:
Establish hierarchy with ink layers and rules; reserve
the floating shadow for the action-menu surface that already uses it.

dos: **Do** use the semantic `--mizu-*` palette so nested light and dark scopes retain their roles.
**Do** pair compact typography with readable secondary text and visible focus.
**Do** keep motion tied to a state change and preserve useful resting and reduced-motion states.
**Do** retain labels, native semantics, keyboard paths and explicit overflow handling.
**Do** qualify synthetic demonstration data and retain navigable documentation headings.
donts: **Don't** replace the incumbent warm material and editorial world with unrelated visual conventions.
**Don't** use diamonds or animation solely to occupy space.
**Don't** turn every container into the same shadowed, rounded card.
**Don't** treat source-backed documentation or the scoped ship verdict as certification of every API.
